assistant_text.text: Let me read the person, machine and doctor info.

Hi Avery, I'm the Smalltalk Assistant.

In the next few minutes I'll show you two agents talking to each other. Then I'll run a small mission. After that I'll ask what you want to get done.

I run on your own Claude or Codex account, so everything I do counts against your usage there. Say "skip" whenever you like and I'll stop.

I started a second agent, called demo. You can see what it said: Hi! One thing I can do is read and edit code in my working directory. We sent each other durable messages, and either of us can wake the other.
Still working through the mission. The writing part is done, and I'm finishing the read-back.

The mission is done. Here is what happened: demo wrote a note and I read it back to you. A notice now sits above the message input.

Your turn, Avery. What do you want to accomplish in Smalltalk today? If you stay quiet, I'll suggest a weekly review.
I didn't hear back, Avery, so I haven't set anything up. You can message me here any time.
